Insert before '## Agent iteration' (exact text):
## Crash recovery of a demo invocation (`run_demo.py --resume`)

`python3 scripts/run_demo.py --resume INVOCATION_ID [--no-latest]` (fallback `just demo-resume ID`) continues one recorded invocation inside the same run directory under the same ID. It replays the receipt's `resume_arguments` and accepts no other settings. A stage is skipped only when its status is success-terminal, every recorded artifact hash matches, its worker file hash is unchanged and every dependency was also skipped; everything downstream of a rerun stage reruns. Outputs of rerun stages are moved, never deleted, into `demo-invocations/<id>/resume-<n>/displaced/` with their hashes. Any hash drift is a typed refusal that writes nothing: `invalid_invocation_id`, `receipt_not_found`, `receipt_invalid`, `receipt_lacks_resume_arguments`, `invocation_already_terminal`, `orchestrator_may_be_alive`, `prior_worker_group_alive`, `resume_lock_held`, `source_hash_drift`, `media_hash_drift`, `stage_artifact_hash_drift`, `worker_hash_drift`, `snapshot_hash_drift`, `media_outcome_unrecorded_run_dir_exists`. Liveness checks use signal 0 only and never signal another process. Resume is crash recovery, not re-analysis, a settings change or a default-adoption path. The memory ceiling remains unknown.
root_owned_changes_requested.why: Document --resume, its skip/dependency rule and the 14 typed refusal codes for agents (ROBUSTNESS_S2 section 9).

findings: (1) Scope holds. `git diff --name-only 0cdca01...HEAD` (merge-base 0cdca019) lists exactly 9 files, all owned: scripts/run_demo.py, tests/test_demo.py, tests/support/phone_fixtures.py, tests/test_phone_fixtures.py, docs/spec/sprints/ROBUSTNESS_S2.md and 4 docs/agent-notes/sprints/20261006-s2/robustness-*.json. No root-owned or foreign file is edited. The contract is untouched after freeze: `git diff 79b56ba..HEAD` does not include ROBUSTNESS_S2.md, and its sha256 7e2fa679...0b91 matches the receipts. The only removed line in tests/test_demo.py is the fake_invoke signature, which gained an `on_started=None` parameter.

(2) No forbidden writes. Every test runs under an isolated ROOT: patched `demo.ROOT`, or copies of scripts/, profiles/ and program/ under the gitignored artifacts/s2/robustness/mkdtemp. Phone fixture runs pass --no-latest. REAL_TAKE (tests/test_phone_fixtures.py:35) is only used in an assertNotEqual. REAL_TAKE_REFERENCE (tests/support/phone_fixtures.py:37) holds constants read at freeze. Nothing writes to program/tools.json, scripts/tool_api.py or just/workflow.just; those are listed only as root_owned_changes_requested in robustness-handoff.json. I found no model download and no daemon.

(4) Reproduced: 40/40. I ran `git archive HEAD` into /tmp/rob-audit so the worktree stayed untouched (git status is still clean). Command: `FFMPEG/FFPROBE=<qualified nix 8.1.2> PYTHONPATH=tests python3 -m unittest test_demo test_phone_fixtures -v`. Result: 'Ran 40 tests in 253.249s OK', 0 skipped. That is 29 in test_demo (17 existing on base plus 12 new: 10 DemoResumeTests and 2 DemoResumeProcessTests) and 11 in test_phone_fixtures. The HEVC run happened. All 7 pipeline runs exited 0 with P1-P8 passing (7/7 per check). Wall time differs between reports (my 253 s, the lane's 612 s for the combined run, the receipt's 1327 s for fixtures alone). I read this as host load. Wall time is labelled a measurement, not a bound.

(4) The tests exercise the claimed behaviour. All 14 typed refusal codes are asserted (exit 1, typed reason, no worker call, byte-identical receipt, identical rglob tree with mtimes): 10 in test_resume_refusals_write_nothing, plus orchestrator_may_be_alive and prior_worker_group_alive (sleeper child asserted still alive), resume_lock_held, and media_outcome_unrecorded_run_dir_exists. A real worker that SIGKILLs itself ends with returncode -9 and then resumes. A real orchestrator SIGKILLed after an ownership check resumes with the same invocation_id and run_dir and exactly one published run.

(5) Doctrine holds. P8 asserts high_pass_applied=False, hum_notches_applied=False, physical_audio_video_sync_verified=False and music_preservation_listening_verified=False, plus memory_ceiling_status 'unknown_not_measured' with memory_ceiling_bytes null. The fixture signal includes a 32.70 Hz C1 tanh burst. Default constants are unchanged: parser defaults moved to None but are filled to the same DEFAULT_PROFILE/stdlib/base/20 before validation (run_demo.py:238-241). STAGE_TIMEOUTS equal the previous literals (1200/600/300/180). Fixture subprocess timeouts are capped at 60 s, and each pipeline subprocess at 600 s.

(6) Arithmetic reproduced. Photo Booth: 144 frames on a 75-ticks-per-3-frames cadence, last pts 3574 + 25 = 3599 ticks, 3599/600 = 5.998333 s. Plus 0.069 s gives 6.067333 s, matching the lavfi duration in the recorded command. Measured tail: 6.067007 - 5.998333 = 0.068674 s, within 0.069 ± (1024/44100 + 0.002) = ±0.02522. Decoded samples 268288 = 262 × 1024, and duration_ts 267555 / 44100 = 6.067007. Phone: audio start 0.228 vs 0.25 - 1024/48000 = 0.22867 (AAC priming), within tolerance 0.02333. Real-take header difference: 150.954059 - 150.905 = 49.059 ms, carried honestly as real_take_audio_tail_reconciled=false.

(3) Claim classes are correct, and every metric has a denominator (9/9, 14/14, 2/2, 4/4, 7/7 per check, 10/10). Fixture results are labelled M (synthetic) and resume results P. The single inference explicitly disclaims real-take equivalence. No verdict keys for notes or missed notes are emitted (P7 scans every run JSON). No profile, detector or default is adopted.

Minor: stale-lock takeover in acquire_lock (run_demo.py) uses a staging-file `replace` without O_EXCL. Two concurrent resumes that both see a dead-PID lock can both report stale_taken_over and run against the same run_dir. The window is narrow (only after an orchestrator crash plus two simultaneous operator resumes). Re-reading the lock after replace, or a link-based acquire, would close it.

Minor: a non-ResumeRefusal exception during prepare_resume (for example a PermissionError while hashing an unreadable source) escapes as a traceback instead of a typed refusal. It still writes nothing, because it is raised before the lock is taken.
Minor: dependency_skip entries and inline skipped stages lack started_at and completed_at, even though §3.2 says every stage records them.

Minor: the phone fixture's effective rate is about 25.7 fps (avg_frame_rate 60000/2327) because every 7th frame is dropped. §4 says '~29.97 fps VFR'; that holds for the nominal 30000/1001 rate, and the VFR requirement (2 distinct durations, 1001 and 2002) is met.

Minor: two documented deviations from the frozen §4 text. The fixture builder adds a lower bound of seconds >= 1.5, and ffprobe calls cannot take -nostdin/-n. Both are recorded in robustness-implementation.json rather than hidden.

Minor: committed host-path text, /Users/jess/Documents/... in tests/test_phone_fixtures.py:35 and the spec. This is consistent with existing main notes, and the repo is private, but recent main commits did scrub host paths from a handoff.

Note: CI (ubuntu, nix develop) will skip test_phone_fixtures because QUALIFIED_BIN is a darwin nix-store path checked by sha256. Fixture coverage is therefore local-only. The test_demo resume tests are portable.
